subject: Pond owner's hat
text: To hook the owner's hat, stand face to face with him and cast so the lure bypasses him and hits the wall.

evidence.quote: Stand closely in front of the owner so you face him face to face. Make sure when you cast the line that the lure bypasses him and hits the wall.

subject: Pond owner's hat
text: Hold A to reel in the line so it attaches to the hat.

evidence.quote: As soon as you can, hold down A to reel in the line and eventually it should attach to the hat.

subject: Pond owner's hat
text: Walk far into the pond, cast, and wait for the hat to sink; the line does not cast far with the hat attached.

evidence.quote: Now, walk far enough into the pond and cast the line and wait for the hat to sink. The line is not cast very far with the hat attached.

subject: Pond owner's hat
text: Throwing the rod back into the pond with the hat unhooks it and sinks it, which unlocks the dialogue and the achievement.

evidence.quote: Once you've managed to grab his hat, just throw the rod back into the pond with it. The hat will unhook and sink, which unlocks the dialogue and the achievement.

subject: Sinking Lure
text: According to one comment, the sinking lure prevents the player from grabbing the hat at all.

evidence.quote: Can confirm that this doesn't work with the sinking lure. You won't be able to grab the hat at all.

subject: Pond owner's hat
text: Another comment says the hat can be grabbed without the sinking lure.

evidence.quote: I can confirm that this *does* work without the sinking lure, so...

subject: Pond owner's hat
text: Saving and quitting after catching the hat, before releasing it, can cause the achievement to be missed.

evidence.quote: I learned the hard way that you can miss this archievement by first catching the hat and hit save & quit before letting it go.

subject: Pond owner's hat
text: After reloading, the owner has still lost his hat but the achievement does not count.

evidence.quote: After reloading the game / save the owner will still have permanently lost his hat but it won't count towards the archievement.

subject: Pond owner's hat
text: Losing the hat costs 50 rupees as a fine.

evidence.quote: You will be fine 50 rupees for this.

subject: Pond owner
text: The invisible walls and hitbox around the pond owner do not match what is visible on screen.

evidence.quote: The space around the pond owner is plastered with invisible walls, and the invisible hitbox is only loosely related to what you can see on screen.

subject: Sinking Lure
text: Take the sinking lure and talk to the owner, because he will allow its use.

evidence.quote: dica pegue a isca que afunda e fale com o dono porque ele vai permitir o uso da isca
evidence.translation: tip: take the sinking lure and talk to the owner because he will allow the use of the lure

subject: Hyrule Loach
text: The Hyrule Loach appears on the left side of the pond; try to catch it first when it appears.

evidence.quote: Enter 3x and talk to the owner of the lake, it appears on the left side, try to get it first.

subject: Hyrule Loach
text: The Hyrule Loach spawns only every 4th attempt at the pond, according to one comment.

evidence.quote: In order for the Hyrule Loach make sure that you know the amount of times you have entered the Loach will only spawn every 4th attempt.

subject: Hyrule Loach
text: Another comment says the loach spawns after every 3 tries, on tries 3, 6, 12, 15, 18 and 21.

evidence.quote: But the loach will spawn after every 3 tries: so 3 , 6 , 12 , 15 ,18 , 21 , etc.

subject: Hyrule Loach
text: Once the loach is spotted, lure the other fish away carefully so the loach does not go deep.

evidence.quote: Once it's spotted lure the other fish away carefully to prevent the loach from going into the deep.

subject: Hyrule Loach
text: The loach can be caught while swimming back down to the surface, not only when it rises for air.

evidence.quote: I seen a lot of videos showing it only being caught as it swims back up for air. However, I was able to get it as it was swimming back down to surface.

subject: Hyrule Loach
text: As adult Link, pay 20 rupees three times without leaving the shop, then leave, re-enter and pay a fourth time for the fish to appear.

evidence.quote: Espanol: Cuando entreis por primera vez a pescar como Link Adulto, paguen 20 rupias tres veces sin salir de la tienda de pescar. Una vez hecho eso, salir de la tienda. Volved a entrar, pagad una cuarta vez, y el pescado aparecera.
evidence.translation: Spanish: When you first go fishing as adult Link, pay 20 rupees three times without leaving the fishing shop. Once that is done, leave the shop. Go back in, pay a fourth time, and the fish will appear.

subject: Accomplished Angler
text: The achievement unlocks just after the caught loach is taken to the vendor.

evidence.quote: Cheevo Pops just after taking it to the vendor

subject: Sinking Lure
text: The sinking lure helps keep fish on the line; keep leaving and re-entering until you get both the lure and the loach.

evidence.quote: the sinking lure definitely helps to keep fish on your line so highly recommend you just keep leaving and coming back until you get both the lure and loach.

subject: Water Temple
text: Save inside the Water Temple before entering the pond on the correct cycle, so you can reset and retry nearby.

evidence.quote: Protip: before entering the fishing pond on the correct cycle, swim down to the water temple and save inside. Then you can just reset if you mess it up and it’s nice and close to try again.

subject: Hyrule Loach
text: The loach behaves like other fish; bring it as close as possible before hooking it.

evidence.quote: Other than that it behaves like any other fish so get it up as close to you as possible before hooking it.

subject: Nearby fish
text: Letting the two nearby fish bite and escape without setting the hook makes them leave the area.

evidence.quote: I did it! Allowing the 2 nearby fish to bite, then allowing them to escape without setting the hook, causes them to leave the area.

subject: Hyrule Loach
text: If the loach does not bite and is close, stay still without pulling the hook out; it returns to its starting position instead of getting scared.

evidence.quote: If it doesn't bite and is close to link, just stay still without pulling your hook out of the water and it will return to its starting position instead of getting scared

subject: Hyrule Loach
text: The easiest loach method needs at least 80 rupees.

evidence.quote: You will need 80 rupees at least.

subject: Hyrule Loach
text: Talk to the owner, say yes to fishing, then quit; repeat this three times in a row.

evidence.quote: Talk to the pond owner and say yes to fishing, then talk to him again to quit. Repeat this three times in a row.

subject: Hyrule Loach
text: After quitting the third time, leave and immediately re-enter the pond area; the loach then spawns below the lily pads on the left side.

evidence.quote: Now, leave the pond area after you quit fishing for the third time and enter the pond area again immediately after. Now the Hyrule Loach has spawned below the lily pads on the left side.

subject: Hyrule Loach
text: Talk to the owner a fourth time and say yes to fishing again.

evidence.quote: Talk to the pond owner for the fourth time and say yes to fishing again.

subject: Nearby fish
text: Bait the two regular fish among the loach, let them bite, and ignore them without moving the controller.

evidence.quote: Now, bait the two regular fish that swims below the lily pads among the loach to bite and when they do, ignore them. Don't push or move anything on your controller.

subject: Nearby fish
text: This makes the fish release the lure and swim to the middle, so the loach is not scared away by them.

evidence.quote: This will make them release the lure and then they will swim towards the middle of the pond. Now the loach won't be scared away by the other two fish if they bit and you tried to reel them in.

subject: Hyrule Loach
text: If the loach lets go and swims to the middle, you need the sinking lure to catch it or must reset and try again.

evidence.quote: If it lets your lure go and swims towards the middle of the pond, you won't be able to just Z-target it anymore and you will need the sinken lure to catch it, or simply just reset the game and try again.

subject: Water Temple
text: Save inside the Water Temple so a reset does not require playing the Serenade of Water to warp to Lake Hylia.

evidence.quote: You can save inside the Water Temple to avoid playing the Serenade of Water to warp to Lake Hylia when resetting the game.

subject: Hyrule Loach
text: After catching the loach, talk to the owner one final time to unlock the achievement.

evidence.quote: After you catch the loach, talk to the owner one final time and the achievement will unlock.

subject: Hyrule Loach
text: Position yourself so the loach and lily pads are between you and the shore, cast onto the shore, and do not scare it to limit interfering fish.

evidence.quote: Basically position yourself so the Loach and Lilly pads are between you and the shore, dont scare it, cast from the water onto the shore and you limit the random fish interfering.

subject: Fishing
text: While reeling in a fish, there is a 256 chance every other frame that it escapes.

evidence.quote: As you're reeling in a fish there's a 256 chance every other frame that it escapes

subject: Fishing
text: Press A as soon as the fish bites to snag it and lock on the hook.

evidence.quote: You need to press the A button as soon as they bite to snag them, aka lock on your hook.

subject: Fishing
text: After snagging, press A again, hold it, and hold the control stick left or right.

evidence.quote: After you press A to snag a fish, press it again and hold it and hold the control stick either left or right.

subject: Hyrule Loach
text: The loach looks different from other fish; enter the pond as adult Link and pay the fee to find it.

evidence.quote: Long story short: this fish looks DIFFERENT than the others, enter the pond as adult link and pay the fee.

subject: Hyrule Loach
text: Check the middle of the pond for the loach resting at the bottom, deeper than the other fish.

evidence.quote: Then check if in the exact middle of the pond there is a weird looking fish right at the bottom, deeper than the other fishes.

subject: Sinking Lure
text: The Sinking Lure is found by walking through certain points, though nothing shows on screen.

evidence.quote: When you find it, then look for the SINKING LURE, it is an item you can find walking through certain points

subject: Pond spawn
text: If the loach is not found after paying, leave and play Sun's Song a couple of times to force the pond to reset.

evidence.quote: If you enter, pay and don’t find it, get out and play sun’s song a couple of times.

subject: Hyrule Loach
text: The loach spawns every 4th time you go in and pay.

evidence.quote: The loach will spawn every 4th time you go in and pay.

subject: Hyrule Loach
text: The loach spawns underneath the lily pads, and the C-Up camera can check whether it is there.

evidence.quote: The loach spawns underneat the lily pads, can use C-Up cam to check if it is there or not.

subject: Hyrule Loach
text: If scared to the middle, the loach sinks to the bottom for about 75 seconds before going up for air.

evidence.quote: It will swim to the middle and sink to the bottom of the pond for about 75 seconds before going up for air and sinking again.

subject: Hyrule Loach
text: The loach is only catchable when at the lily pads or swimming directly to them.

evidence.quote: The loach is ONLY catchable either when it is at the lily pads or swimming to the lily pads directly.

subject: Hyrule Loach
text: As Young Link, two loaches spawn when you hit the correct cycle.

evidence.quote: Here's a tip! When you're Young Link, TWO Loaches will spawn when you hit the correct cycle.

subject: Hyrule Loach
text: The second loach is at the other set of lily pads, on the right when facing the pond with your back to the door.

evidence.quote: the other will be at the other set of lilypads (on the right if you're facing the pond with your back to the door).

subject: Hyrule Loach
text: One player found the repeated 20 rupee payment method did not work for them.

evidence.quote: For some reason, the "repeat paying 20 rupees 3x, leave, go in, pay again" didn't work at all on my end.

subject: Hyrule Loach
text: The loach eventually spawned on the third try after checking both lily pad spawn points as Young Link.

evidence.quote: Eventually, maybe on my third try, the Hyrule Loach did spawn.

subject: Hyrule Loach
text: Paying the fishing spot four times guarantees a Hyrule Loach spawn.

evidence.quote: Basically, you'll have to pay the fishing spot four times in order for a guaranteed spawn for the Loach.

subject: Hyrule Loach
text: As child Link, two loach spawns are near the lily pads.

evidence.quote: There are two near the lily pads if you play as child Link.

subject: Hyrule Loach
text: As adult Link, there is only one spawn, at the left lily pads.

evidence.quote: But there's only one at the left lily pads as adult Link.

subject: Hyrule Loach
text: The Hyrule Loach can be caught with the regular lure, though the sinking lure can make it easier.

evidence.quote: While the sinking lure could make this catch easier, it's definitely possible to catch the Hyrule Loach with the regular lure.
